Update Public Cloud Id Info
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/publicCloudAccountIdStatus

Enables/disables public (Cloud Connector) cloud account status.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
accountIdEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether public cloud account is enabled.

subIdEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether public cloud subscription is enabled.

Responses
​
default

Default Response. See API Response Codes

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
accountIdEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether public cloud account is enabled.

subIdEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether public cloud subscription is enabled.
